title: Redis Data Structures & Persistence
recap: Redis ek in-memory data store hai jo Strings, Hashes, Lists, Sets aur Sorted Sets jaise rich data structures provide karta hai. Persistence ke liye RDB snapshots periodic state save karte hain jabki AOF har write command ka append log rakhta hai.
